artifact.summary: Implements eq_1 only: a reversible cascade G_n o ... o G_1 of NOT, CNOT and Toffoli gates on a 4-line register (n_qubits is configurable up to 12). The instance supplies the ordered gate list, with the first gate applied first, and the circuit is a measurement-free unitary operation. The quantum-cost sum, GC/QC minimization and saving computation are classical and are not part of the circuit.
register_layout: qubit 0 = x_0 (least significant bit of the 4-bit integer)
Computational-basis encoding: basis state |x> with x = sum_i x_i 2^i; the circuit acts as the permutation f on basis states

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit: loop over parsed gates appending x/cx/ccx in order
equation_mapping.explanation: The cascade G_n o ... o G_1 is realized by applying the listed gates sequentially, with the first listed gate applied first. The permutation f is whatever the supplied network computes.
Exact gate-count minimization is a classical search by an unspecified tool. The code only validates the library (NOT, CNOT, Toffoli) and does not minimize anything.
Quantum cost is a classical cost metric on the gate list (assumed NOT=1, CNOT=1, Toffoli=5). It does not alter the unitary and is not emitted by the circuit builder.
QC minimization is a classical synthesis/optimization objective whose mechanism is unspecified in the abstract.
The percentage saving is classical post-processing comparing published circuits and has no circuit counterpart.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to building the Toffoli-network operation for a user-supplied gate list (eq_1). Synthesis, optimization, cost evaluation and saving computation are not implemented.
specification_changes.reason: The abstract gives no synthesis algorithm, and the cost and optimization steps are classical and cannot be expressed as a quantum operation.

specification_changes.change: The gate network is supplied as instance input rather than derived from a target permutation f.
specification_changes.reason: Deriving the network requires the unspecified optimal synthesis tool; no benchmark function was provided.

assumptions: Gate library is NOT, CNOT and Toffoli (controls list of length 0, 1 or 2).
Gates are applied in list order, with gates[0] = G_1 applied first.
Qubit i holds bit x_i, with qubit 0 the least significant bit.
n_qubits defaults to 4 when absent; values from 1 to 12 are accepted, with at most 500 gates.
The circuit is a pure operation with no input-state preparation or measurement.
unresolved_issues: How the optimal-GC tool is adapted to minimize quantum cost is not specified.
The exact quantum-cost table is not specified in the abstract.
No benchmark functions or reference circuits are supplied, so no specific permutation is reconstructed.

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
